card.name: Linking words before overdose treatments
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "that" and "as" right after nouns like use, usefulness or value in overdose-management text. The next word is usually a treatment such as hemodialysis, activated charcoal or a drug name.

modes.label: Use of a treatment
modes.description: The word "of" after "use", "usefulness" or "value", leading into a named overdose treatment.
